column1: # catalog/plan-failure-modes.tsv — the failure-mode checklist a plan answers when it
# changes bin/ or worker/ (BH-5800, prompts/plan-contract.md §13). Read by
# bin/lib/plan-failure-modes.sh: bin/plan-gate.sh refuses a plan without it, and
# the plan prompt is rendered from it. Tab-separated: kind, id, ERE, label, question.
# kind scope: a plan that names a path matching the ERE needs the section. A
# repo-relative path, or one rooted at /root/harness/ or $HARNESS/, counts.
# kind heading: one checklist entry. The ERE is matched against the start of a
# bullet or heading line inside `## Failure modes`, lower-cased.

column4: a path under bin/ or worker/
column5: the plan changes code in bin/ or worker/

for each decision rule, a table of 2 or more cases on each side, including the edge case and the near misses (negation, partial match, other formats and versions, data past page 1, inherited state, cases an earlier filter removed, success lines next to errors), each from a live source or marked source: assumed, and a test that asserts every case
for each exit path, the state it leaves and the budget or counter it touches
for each new format, every writer and every reader, and a test that round-trips it
for each new alert or freeze, its worst-case count on the first tick and its scope
for each new knob, its default in prod and why
for each status or report line, the evidence that makes it say done
